top_signals.title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company
top_signals.summary: The restructuring will separate MetaMask’s consumer business from Consensys’ Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure operations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: FirstRand Profit Falls as $1.1 Billion Provision Curbs Gains
top_signals.summary: FirstRand Ltd. profit fell for the first time in six years after a £807 million ($1.1 billion) provision for UK clients’ claims over missold car loans at its British motor-finance unit countered growth from loans and fee income.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Australia Softens Gas Reservation Rule for LNG Exporters
top_signals.summary: Australia’s government has relaxed gas supply rules for producers aimed at securing enough gas for the domestic market. Originally, the rules stipulated that producers should reserve 20% of output for the Australian market. Now, the proposal is for up to 20% of output to be reserved for the domestic market. The proposal was first tabled in May this year, in response to worry about looming gas shortages in parts of the country, notably the east coast.
